# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas
{
  "type": "16:9 full-slide PowerPoint image",
  "language": "Korean",
  "slide_number": 4,
  "render_slide_number": false
}

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "core_claim": "ETRI analyzed NPU execution conditions and low-level paths, implemented custom-stage replacement and actual KV-transfer NPU PD runtimes, and developed lmd-top for model operations. These are separate research implementations, not one finished automatic controller.",
    "narrative": "1 whole map → 2 conditions problem → 3 low-level entry points → 4 custom code integration → 5 stage separation → 6 operations → 7 collaboration return to map.",
    "facts": "Hardware/vendor compiler/Kubernetes/Prometheus are reused infrastructure, not ETRI inventions. PD is a split execution method, not IR. Do not claim GPU-NPU PD completed: completed PD records are RNGD/ATOM. No benchmark numbers. May not claim all custom kernels verified. lmd-top manages vendor compile Jobs, not compiler itself."
  },
  "slide_local_context": "L8Swapper is ETRI tool to compile/replace stage binary in vendor artifact and validate dispatch. Rust verification includes passthrough dispatch, not full attention replacement correctness. No code or implementation API list."
}

## Global Style
{
  "palette": "ETRI blue #005EB8, navy text, pure white, pale blue research modules, muted gray supporting infrastructure",
  "typography": "Large impeccably readable Korean sans, title ~44px equivalent; short labels, generous whitespace",
  "rules": "16:9 full slide image; no page numbers; no decorative stripes; ETRI wordmark at upper right as approved sample. One main diagram, maximum three explanation groups; do not repeat long footer sentences."
}

## Input Images

- Image 1: /home/<user>/llm-d-setup/docs/presentations/ETRI_NPU_TopDown_v10/origin_image/slide_01.png — Approved style only: blue/white Korean technical presentation. Vary layout, do not repeat full stack.


## Slide
{
  "number": 4,
  "title": "실행의 일부를 바꿔볼 수 있는 기반을 만들었습니다",
  "role": "before / after replacement",
  "intent": "Explain concrete ETRI implementation L8Swapper, not generic custom kernel possibility."
}

## Text
{
  "title": "실행의 일부를 바꿔볼 수 있는 기반을 만들었습니다",
  "key_points": [],
  "speaker_focus": null
}

## Layout
Create one full 16:9 Korean technical slide matching attached approved slide1 ETRI blue/white style, navy large title, ETRI upper right, no page numbers. Title: 실행의 일부를 바꿔볼 수 있는 기반을 만들었습니다. One large conceptual illustration: a gray outlined container labeled '기존 NPU 실행 엔진', inside a left-to-right three-block flow '기존 실행' → bright blue '직접 작성한 코드' → '기존 실행'. Above the blue block a small code-file icon with an arrow entering it labeled '우리가 개발한 연결 도구'. This shows local replacement within retained vendor engine, not engine rewrite. Below only two short plain-language statements: '엔진 전체를 바꾸지 않고 필요한 부분만 수정' and '수정한 코드가 실제 호출되는 경로 확인'. Bottom small connection to next slide: '실행 일부 변경 → 실행 단계를 다른 NPU로 분리'. Do not use L8Swapper, stage, binary, artifact, dispatch, input/output specs, Rust or any API names. No before-after duplicate flow, no 5-stage workflow, no benchmarks. Do not imply fully implemented attention or measured acceleration. Large icons, clear hierarchy, generous whitespace.

## Style Reference Rule
Use Image 1 as the approved sample-slide style reference. Match its palette, typography mood, density, texture, and overall visual identity. Do not copy its exact layout unless this slide's layout explicitly asks for it.

## Input Image Handling Rules
For any input image marked as a strict input asset, include it visibly and preserve its content. Do not redraw, replace, relabel, or invent a similar figure. Scale and crop only as needed for composition while keeping the important labels, arrows, data, and relationships recognizable.

## Universal Constraints
- The final image itself must contain the title and key points.
- Render Chinese text exactly and legibly; avoid garbled characters.
- Keep the confirmed deck style consistent while varying layout by slide role.
- No watermark, unrelated logo, or extra slide number.
